# Flint

> Flint helps healthcare professionals on temporary status find sponsored U.S. healthcare jobs, and gives hospitals, clinics and care facilities vetted, green card sponsored staff.

Flint connects nurses and other healthcare professionals with employers that sponsor a green card from day one, with filing, lawyer and relocation costs covered. This file lists the main pages of the site.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://fint-fc2589.webflow.io/): Flint helps healthcare professionals on temporary status find sponsored healthcare jobs.
- [Candidates](https://fint-fc2589.webflow.io/candidates): For nurses and healthcare professionals on temporary status looking for U.S. jobs with green card sponsorship, with filing, lawyer and relocation costs covered.
- [Facility partners](https://fint-fc2589.webflow.io/facility-partners): For hospitals, clinics and care facilities hiring from 100,000+ vetted healthcare professionals with green card sponsorship, to cut staffing costs.
- [About](https://fint-fc2589.webflow.io/about): Flint was founded in 2024 to build a permanent path to the U.S. for healthcare professionals, with hospitals ready to sponsor a green card from day one.
- [Blog](https://fint-fc2589.webflow.io/blog): Immigration, licensing, and hiring tips for healthcare workers seeking visa sponsorship, with guides on green card sponsorship for CNAs, LPNs, and RNs.

## Legal

- [Privacy Policy](https://fint-fc2589.webflow.io/privacy-policy): How Flint Healthcare collects, uses, and shares your information, including SMS messaging data, and the choices and rights you have.
